arguments.subject: Acme Q1 Market Data Information
arguments.body:
Dear Priya,

Please find below the Q1 market data for Acme Corporation, drawn from our internal briefing records:

Category Share (Protein Bars):
- January: 18.4% (Nielsen scanner Q4-Q1 pull, US total) – share up 60bps QoQ, driven by club channel reset
- February: 18.6% (Nielsen scanner Feb pull, US total) – share holding, Verdant flat (see analyst note)
- March: 18.9% (Nielsen scanner March pull, US total) – share continuing to grow, Verdant flat-to-down

Retail Velocity (Top Protein Bar SKU):
- January: 4.7 units/store/week (IRI scan, US total) – steady, remains a top-3 SKU in the category
- February: 4.9 units/store/week (IRI scan, US total) – uptick, Q1 promo driving trial
- March: 5.1 units/store/week (IRI scan, US total) – best Q1 reading, momentum continues

Regional Momentum:
- Southeast: +12% YoY (Acme syndicated dashboard) – strongest region, pull-through from Walmart reset
- West: +8% YoY (Acme syndicated dashboard) – below plan (+12%), some competitive pressure from private labels
- Northeast: +9% YoY (Acme syndicated dashboard) – steady, no notable competitive shifts

Promo Lift:
- January (MLK weekend): +22% (Acme syndicated dashboard) – outperformed planned +15%
- February (Super Bowl window): +18% (Acme syndicated dashboard) – met plan

Share of Voice (Digital):
- February: 33% of category SOV (Pathmatics digital ad scrape, US total) – leading category, Verdant at 24%
- March: 34% of category SOV (Pathmatics digital ad scrape, US total) – steady leadership

If you need further detail or data, the full briefing record is available upon request. Please let me know how you’d like to proceed or if you require the original file as an attachment.

Best regards,
Daniel Park
Pinecrest Strategy Group
